speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; to help me determine the cause, how old are you in days or weeks, and has your stool been passed?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of a brother with pyloric stenosis and the age of six hours strongly suggest malrotation with volvulus rather than hypertrophic pyloric stenosis. Can you tell me if the vomit is green or bile-colored, and have you noticed any abdominal distension or an "olive-like" mass? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound
